_meta.notes: C01 client foundation: quality tiers, resolution floor, camera smoothing, idle-drop timeout. C02/C03 own the plant and environment shader values.

target_fps.notes: Render-loop target frames per second on the current tier.

fps_warning_threshold.notes: Fraction of target_fps at which the client downgrades resolution.

resolution_floor.notes: Minimum renderer pixel ratio relative to devicePixelRatio.

camera_max_polar_angle.notes: Max polar angle in radians (keeps camera above ground).

idle_drop_timeout_ms.notes: Ms of no input before the render loop throttles to 10 fps.

debug_overlay_enabled.notes: Toggle the C01 debug overlay (fps, triangles, draw calls, memory, network).

debug_overlay_key.notes: Keyboard code that toggles the debug overlay.

pause_on_hidden.notes: Pause the render loop and stop sending INPUT when the tab is hidden.

sky_zenith_day.notes: Sky zenith color during clear day.

sky_horizon_day.notes: Sky horizon color during clear day.

sky_zenith_dusk.notes: Sky zenith color during dawn/dusk transitions.

sky_horizon_dusk.notes: Sky horizon color during dawn/dusk transitions.

sky_zenith_telegraph.notes: Sky zenith color during storm telegraph phase.

sky_horizon_telegraph.notes: Sky horizon color during storm telegraph phase.

sun_color_day.notes: Directional sun color during clear day.

sun_color_night.notes: Directional celestial light color during night (moonlight).

sun_intensity_day.notes: Direct solar light intensity at peak noon.

sun_intensity_night.notes: Direct celestial light intensity at midnight.

fog_near_clear.notes: Fog near distance during clear weather.

fog_far_clear.notes: Fog far distance during clear weather.

fog_near_storm.notes: Fog near distance during active storm.

fog_far_storm.notes: Fog far distance during active storm.

rain_particle_count.notes: Number of precipitation particles simulated in camera volume.

rain_particle_speed.notes: Vertical descent speed of rain particles in m/s.

rain_box_width.notes: Horizontal dimensions of rain bounding volume centered on camera.

rain_box_height.notes: Vertical dimension of rain bounding volume.

lightning_flash_duration_ms.notes: Duration of an atmospheric lightning flash in milliseconds.

lightning_intensity_boost.notes: Peak light intensity multiplier during lightning flash.

lightning_min_interval_s.notes: Minimum delay in seconds between lightning strikes during thunderstorm.

lightning_max_interval_s.notes: Maximum delay in seconds between lightning strikes during thunderstorm.

soil_dry_color.notes: Terrain soil tint when moisture is low.

soil_wet_color.notes: Terrain soil tint when moisture is high or after rain.

soil_mineral_tint.notes: Subtle mineral accent tone on ground terrain.

terrain_mesh_subdivisions.notes: Subdivision radial segments of the terrain ground mesh.

terrain_radius.notes: World radius of the ground terrain mesh.
